sourceText:
Oatmeal Applesauce Cookies
By: Helen Pitlick
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




1 cup whole wheat flour pastry, sifted
1/2 teaspoon baking soda
1 1/2 cups rolled oats
1/4 cup egg substitute
1/4 teaspoon cinnamon
1/4 teaspoon nutmeg
1/2 cup sucanat or maple syrup granules
 cup applesauce
1/2 cup skim milk
1 teaspoon vanilla
1 cup raisins

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Sift together flour, soda, and spices. 2 Stir in oats. Combine egg substitute, sucanat, applesauce, milk, vanilla and raisins; add to flour mixture. Mix well. Drop batter onto greased cookie sheets and bake 12-15 minutes.
